content.text:
[b][size=15]
Detail Button
	•	Toggles visibility of knob and switch functions on the synth interface.
Patch Bay Button

Opens or closes the patch bay popup.
	•	In Editor Mode, you can drag between an input and output point to draw a cable between them.
	•	You can right click on a point to remove the cable.
	•	In Loading Mode, patches are premade and no connections are needed. 

Patch Selector
	•	Clicking a patch opens the loading page to view its details and patch bay layout.
	•	Right-clicking a patch plays a preview of the selected sound.

Patch Library
	•	Patches uploaded by pressing Command + U are reviewed and tested before adding to the library. 
	•	The contents of the text box aren't currenly uploaded but you can specify any details you want to share in the desciption text box.
